verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ELSTER as an online, paperless filing portal where submission requires a free one-time Mein ELSTER registration. Nothing in the pack documents that the forms themselves or their instructions can be downloaded from the site without an account. The esteuer.de probe concerns ERiC developer artifact bundles, not the forms or their instructions, and that host now times out, so it does not support this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
